title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Tract No. 83550, located at 3401 South La Cienega, southerly of Jefferson Boulevard.
text:
[Council File 26-1530; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Tract No. 83550, located at 3401 South La Cienega, southerly of Jefferson Boulevard.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Tract No. 83350, located at 3401 South La Cienega, southerly of Jefferson Boulevard and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
C-147062
Owner: La Cienega Owner LLC and La Cienega Multifamily Owner LLC ; Surveyor: Christopher M. Jones
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $14,080 for the processing of this final tract map pursuant to Section 19.02(A)(2) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted.
